canonicalization.dedup_rule: ASJP language page, exported rows/API representations, mirrors and search results are manifestations of one ASJP dataset identity, not independent corroborating sources.
canonicalization.upstream_dependency: Peiros 1998 is explicitly cited by ASJP and must be dependency-tagged for claims or lexical forms derived from it.
